title: Facilitating Fine-grained Detection of Chinese Toxic Language: Hierarchical Taxonomy, Resources, and Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Multi-label classification of sexism in Chinese text using pre-trained language models (BiLSTM, BERT, RoBERTa) enhanced with a Toxic Knowledge Enhancement (TKE) module evaluated on the custom TOXICN dataset.

Multi-label classification of racism in Chinese text using pre-trained language models (BiLSTM, BERT, RoBERTa) enhanced with a Toxic Knowledge Enhancement (TKE) module evaluated on the custom TOXICN dataset.

Multi-label classification of regional discrimination in Chinese text using pre-trained language models (BiLSTM, BERT, RoBERTa) enhanced with a Toxic Knowledge Enhancement (TKE) module evaluated on the custom TOXICN dataset.

Multi-label classification of anti-LGBTQ hate speech in Chinese text using pre-trained language models (BiLSTM, BERT, RoBERTa) enhanced with a Toxic Knowledge Enhancement (TKE) module evaluated on the custom TOXICN dataset.
